notes: A bounded translation of the native-green 70-assertion HLA_EVOKED restore TSO retraction-designator uniqueness case. A saved queued timestamped directed interaction survives restore; a post-save designator becomes invalid; a fresh post-restore allocation differs from both older handles and can be retracted without suppressing the saved passel. Flush Queue Request delivers exactly the saved directed interaction before its grant; retracting its saved handle yields Request Retraction and a terminal second-retraction exception. C++ primary/contract passed in an isolated executable linked only to the installed 2026-10-20 package with integer64 and float64 time. Adapter supplies libraries, endpoint, standard FOM object/attribute/interaction names, time implementation, and HLA_EVOKED callback model. Java compiles against the pinned official API-only JAR; Java provider runtime, other callback models, distributed persistence, and conformance are unverified.
